content: Ngwiiyà a Yɛsu
Ilä a làmiŋ ututu tutu, akaar bàkyen kà an'dii, bàsyen may a usɔŋ bàläm ba.
Ba bàmɛn naa nkɔŋ yàkäl u mun a an'dii bàkyàbuum ukɔl.
Waa bàbilà, wɛɛ ba bàmɛn anki ndür a Mwol Yɛsu.
Kyekà mpal bàkäl ba mubem ndaa ayi, wɛɛ le, baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàŋàbwaar ipfɛy a in'ŋyäŋ bàyàmɛnà tsütsü apà ba.
Bɔɔmà lawɛl la, laa bàtsüüm ba u mɛɛn, waa bàtɛn a ba naa: « Ntɔn nkye làleŋà bɛ mbuur a mɔ̈ɔ̈ uboo a akü?
Nde papà watɛy, nde akyàwiyà. Làyɔbà ndaa kàlakyään nde mpal kàkäl nde u Ngalilɛ
anà kàtɛn nde naa: "Yubwaŋ naa Mwan a mbuur bun'yälà akà baar abe, bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi, waa nde uwiyà kà ilä kyàtär." »
Apan ba bàyɔbà ndaa a Yɛsu.
Ba bàlwomà kà an'dii, waa bàkàkyään ndaa ayi yanswà akà Bàkwem Aŋimwɛy anà akà alɔŋki bumwɛy banswà.
Akaar aban bàkäl Màlye a Magàdalà, Zwan anà Màlye ngwän a Zyak. Akaar bumwɛy bàkäl anà ba bàkàkyään ndaa nsil ayi akà antööm.
Wɛɛ ba làkwikilà bàsi anki ntɔn ya yàkäl asànaa ndwɛy a mwäänà.
Itàkal abwɛy, Petɔlà waa kàmbarà, kàpaarà ntiin mukyà an'dii, laa kànyee nde, kàmɛn nde in'siŋ a ipfɛy mpɛl, waa kàfurà ndwà ande wàmuyibem ndaa yàlyaaŋ.
U mbwo a Ɛmayüs
Yàmɛnà naa ilä nsil akin, alɔŋki bööl bàkäl mukyà bul mwɛy ikɔb a la Ԑmayüs, la làkäl isii an'taaŋ mɔ̈ɔ̈l mà dwaan a Yɛlusàlɛm.
Ba bàkäl muyiyääm ndaa yanswà yàlyaaŋ.
Mpal bàkäl ba muyiyääm, Yɛsu ŋakwo kàsin tsütsü apà ba, waa uyikyà mbwo mwɛy anà ba.
Ba bàkyer un'manà, wɛɛ mii a ba myapɛɛ anki mbwo muyöb naa awà nde.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Bɛ ininà làyiyääm u mbwo làyikyà bɛ? » Ba waa bàmbär, anà ngyɛb yanswà.
Umwɛy uboo a ba ikɔb ande Klɔpas waa kun'fuul: « Ngye, ngye awà un'nsi Yɛlusàlɛm umwɛy mpɛl mpa uyöb indiir ikalyaaŋà ilä abi? »

Nde waa kafuul naa: « Ininà bà? » Ba waa bun'fuur naa: « Ndaa yàbweel Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr! Nde kàkäl ŋangɔɔm a ngwal. Nde ya kàswɛŋ unsà nsyääl ande anà ndaa ande kusà a Nzam anà kusà a un'sɛŋ wanswà.
Wɛɛ amfum a angaŋ abi anà abyääl abi bàkyer aben mukun'yälà ntɔn bun'tsüül mbar a ukwà, waa bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Wɛɛ bi, bi kàsi làkyän naa nde mbuur ayàkɔɔr Isàlɛl. Udu a ayi yanswà, wɛɛ le, ŋàbawà ilä kyàtär sɛmà yan'lyaaŋ ndaa ayi yanswà.
Yà ndandaa naa akaar amwɛy uboo a un'tüüb abi bàyikyään ndaa a ubem: ba bàkyen ututu tutu kà an'dii,
wɛɛ ba bàmɛn anki ndür ande. Waa ba bàyikyään sye naa akyeey a du bàyàmɛnà akà ba ntɔn mukakyään naa nde we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Bumwɛy uboo abi waa bàkyen kà an'dii, ba bàmɛn asànaa bàtɛn akaar, wɛɛ ba nde bun'mɛn anki. »
Apan Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ɔɔ bɛ baar làkɔ̈ɔ̈n un'yɛnà, u mpem mpa ifàyöb agyägyä ndaa yanswà bàtɛn aŋangɔɔm!
Yàlɔ̈m anki naa Klistɔ umɛn mpay ayi yanswà, waa ubilà u làkoo ande? »
Ungö, nde kakyään indiir byanswà bàsön ntɔn nde sɛmà Mɔsɛ tii aŋangɔɔm banswà.
Mpal nsil ayin, ba bàtöl tsütsü a bul bàkäl ba mukyà. Yàmɛnà asànaa Yɛsu alab mbwo ande.
Wɛɛ ba bun'si muküünà, waa bàtɛn naa: « Kal anà bi, ngye akimanà naa taaŋ làmuminà, mpib yàmubwà. » Nde kàbilà u ndwà ntɔn mukal anà ba.
Nde kàbwaay u mɛsà anà ba, waa kàwɛl mampà, ungö mufuur antɔɔn, nde kàtsül ma, waa kapɛ.
Apan, mii aba waa myàdubà, bun'yöb ba, wɛɛ taaŋ nsil alan, laa kàyaalà nde kusà aba.
Ba waa bàsàbulà mutɛn un'tɔŋ a un'tɔŋ naa: « Mpem abi yàböl anki mpal uyitɛɛn nde u mbwo anà uyibuul nde Ndaa Aŋàsɔn? »
Taaŋ nsil alan waa bàmbarà, waa bàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm. Akun ba bàmɛn Bàkwem Aŋimwɛy ban'köŋ anà baar bàkäl anà ba.
Ba banswà bawɛl ubwaŋ. Apan ba bàtɛn a ba naa: « Ndandaa Mwol akyàwiyà, nde amɛnà akà Simɔn. »
Apan alɔŋki bɔ̈ɔ̈l abà bakyään indiir byanswà byàlyaaŋ u mbwo anà ba Yɛsu bun'yöb aben mpal kàtsül nde mampà.
Yɛsu an'yàmɛnà akà alɔŋki ande
Mpal bàkäl ba muyäämà abà, Yɛsu ŋakwo kàyàmɛnà uboo a ba, waa kàtɛn naa: « Duu làkäl anà bɛ. »
Wɛɛ ba bàkäl unsà ubem anà u bɔɔmà ntɔn ba bàsii naa ba ban'man buulà.
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ntɔn nkye lan'bulà bɛ udu udu? Ntɔn nkye nkyɛɛr yan'bilà ya u mpem abɛ?
Làler an'kɔɔ amɛ anà in'kɔl amɛ: awà mɛ. Lan'tɛ mpi anà làler! Ntɔn buulà ufàkal anki anà in'twaŋ anà in'kwo. Wɛɛ bɛ làkimanà naa mɛ in'we anà mya. »
Mpal kàtɛɛnà nde abwɛy, nde kàkälà muswaŋ an'kɔɔ ande anà in'kɔl ande.
Abun, unsà un'sak, ba bàkwe anki musà làkwikilà, ba bàkäl mubem. Apan nde waa kafuul naa: « Nkye bɛ làwe anà undiir adyà apà? »
Ba bun'pɛ itsu a nsö aŋàyaŋ.
Nde kàwɛl kya, waa kàdi kya u mii aba.
Ungö, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Bɛ lan'man ndaa kàtɛn mɛ a bɛ mpal kàkäl mɛ anà bɛ: "Yubwaŋ naa ndaa yanswà bàsön ntɔn mɛ uboo a Un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ, Aŋangɔɔm anà An'diim yan'mɛnà u mii." »
Apan nde kaduub un'yɛnà ntɔn ba bàyöb Ndaa Aŋàsɔn.
Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Bàsön naa: "Klistɔ ayàman ntaan, nde akyer ayàwiyà kà ilä kyàtär,
waa bàyàlɔŋ kà ikɔb ande akà baar a in'sɛŋ myanswà, sɛmà Yɛlusàlɛm, naa ba bàkyer asɔɔmà, waa bàwal ndwääl a nkul a man'be aba.
Bɛ làbà ambäl a indiir abi byanswà.
Waa mɛ, mɛ in'yàlatööm undiir kàlapɛ Taa ilää. Wɛɛ akà bɛ, làkäl apà uboo a bul a kölàköl tii mpal làsàyɔl bɛ anà ngwal isàfà du. »
Yɛsu kan'beenà du
Ungö, nde kasyen u nsà a bul a tsütsü a Bɛtani, nde kàsɛn an'kɔɔ ande, waa kasaak.
Mpal kàkäl nde mukasaak, nde kàkaabà anà ba, waa bun'syen u du.
Wɛɛ akà ba, ungö mukun'sà làkoo, ba bàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm unsà un'sak mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ ba bàkälà taaŋ lanswà u ndwà a Nzam musyaŋà Nzam.
